nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes:
POST {target_path, workspace_id?, paths?, options?} to /webhook/wylde-ingest.
Contract matches Core/harness/memory/ingest.py::trigger_ingest.

nodes.name: Discover Files
nodes.notes: Pre-chunk wiring. One item per file flows into the chunker below.

nodes.name: Chunk (Tree-sitter Sidecar)
nodes.notes:
AST-BOUNDARY CHUNKER — Slice 2.
Replaces the old heuristic text splitter (recursive-character / fixed line
windows) with the Rust tree-sitter sidecar. Calls the sidecar's localhost
HTTP front door directly (POST /chunk {path, language?, max_chunk_bytes?}).
NO Python adapter, NO Execute-Command CLI shim — N8N's built-in HTTP Request
node straight to the Rust service.
Reply: {path, language, ast_aware, chunk_count, chunks:[{start_line,end_line,
byte_start,byte_end,kind,symbol_name?}]}. Chunks fall on function/class
boundaries; unknown languages fall back to byte windows.

nodes.name: Extract Entities (Tree-sitter Sidecar)
nodes.notes:
STRUCTURAL ENTITY EXTRACTION — Slice 3.
Same sidecar, same direct-HTTP pattern as the chunker (NO Python wrapper, NO
CLI shim). POST /extract_entities {path, language?} per file. The `path`
comes through unchanged on the chunk reply, so this node reads $json.path.
Reply: {path, language, module, functions:[{name,line}],
classes:[{name,line,methods,bases}], imports:[{module,line}],
calls:[{caller,callee,line}], counts}.
continueOnFail so a parse error on one file doesn't abort the ingest — the
Build node degrades to chunks-without-entities.

nodes.name: Build Graph + Attach Entities
nodes.notes:
Slice 3 core wiring. Joins the chunk list + entity list per file, attaches
entities to each chunk by line range, and emits the memgraph upsert/relate
payloads. Fans out to BOTH the embed branch and the Memgraph graph branch.

nodes.name: Expand Chunks
nodes.notes:
Embed branch: flattens each file's mem_chunks into one item per chunk, now
carrying the attached `entities` (Slice 3).

nodes.name: Embed + Index
nodes.notes:
Embed branch: embed the chunk text + write to LanceDB via wylde-rag. The
chunk record now carries `entities` (Slice 3) so the vector store and the
graph store share an entity set. continueOnFail so a single bad chunk doesn't
abort the whole ingest.

nodes.name: Memgraph Upsert (Entities)
nodes.notes:
GRAPH BRANCH — Slice 3. POST /upsert {chunks:[{id, path, symbol, language,
entities}]} to the Memgraph service's HTTP front door (same dual pipe+HTTP
shape memgraph.py uses; HTTP default 127.0.0.1:8010). Creates Chunk + Entity
nodes and the MENTIONS edges. Existing route — no Memgraph protocol change.
continueOnFail so a graph-write outage never blocks the vector ingest.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ rel_type: 'CALLS', pairs: $('Build Graph + Attach Entities').item.json.calls_pairs }) }}

nodes.name: Memgraph Relate CALLS
nodes.notes:
GRAPH BRANCH — Slice 3. POST /relate {rel_type:'CALLS', pairs:[{source:caller,
target:callee}]}. rel_type is validated server-side against
{CALLS,IMPORTS,INHERITS,CONFIGURES,EXPOSES} — CALLS is in-set, existing route.
Reads the edge list from the Build node by name (the upstream HTTP response
replaced $json).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ rel_type: 'IMPORTS', pairs: $('Build Graph + Attach Entities').item.json.imports_pairs }) }}

nodes.name: Memgraph Relate IMPORTS
nodes.notes:
GRAPH BRANCH — Slice 3. POST /relate {rel_type:'IMPORTS', pairs:[{source:module,
target:imported_module}]}. source is the importing file's module identity.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ rel_type: 'INHERITS', pairs: $('Build Graph + Attach Entities').item.json.inherits_pairs }) }}

nodes.name: Memgraph Relate INHERITS
nodes.notes:
GRAPH BRANCH — Slice 3. POST /relate {rel_type:'INHERITS', pairs:[{source:class,
target:base}]}. Base classes come from the class_definition superclasses.
